reviews.evidence: The patch moves the current mat-mdc-slider theme onto MDC slider token maps, including active-track height 6px and handle size 20px. It does not touch legacy-slider. The owned slider styles do not reference mdc-slider tokens, and they were not changed.

The patch skips _onChange while typing when requireSelection is set, and the MDC spec then expects the model to stay at the previous object instead of the typed string Cali. legacy-autocomplete/internal/autocomplete-trigger-base.ts already has that same guard and comment. No source was changed.

The patch deletes upstream _theming.scss and the .import.scss and -legacy-index.scss shims, and says @import is no longer supported. This package still has 29 .import.scss files and the legacy-index forwards, including legacy-button and legacy-slider. None of those files were deleted.

The patch makes MatChipOption._handlePrimaryActionInteraction call focus() before toggleSelected, to clear a Safari focus leftover. The owned chips have no MatChipOption and no _handlePrimaryActionInteraction, and that method was not added.

The patch keeps the MDC slider thumb active on iOS only when the pointer is on the thumb, and it skips pointer focus and animation on iOS. The owned slider has no MatSliderThumb and sets _isActive from the focus origin. That iOS path was not added.

The patch moves MDC checkbox unthemable tokens from checkbox.scss into a new checkbox-base mixin called by checkbox-theme. The owned forward lists checkbox-theme, color, typography, and density, and styles/checkbox/_checkbox-theme.scss has no base mixin. That mixin was not added.

The patch deletes the MDC text-field theme-variable refresh and moves mat-mdc-form-field colors onto tokens. styles/form-field/_form-field-theme.scss still calls private-text-field-refresh-theme-variables, and the refresh file is still present. Those styles were not rewritten.

The patch adds progress-bar-base and emits MDC linear-progress unthemable tokens from progress-bar-theme. The owned forward lists progress-bar-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/progress-bar/_progress-bar-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds tooltip-base and emits MDC plain-tooltip unthemable tokens from tooltip-theme. The owned forward lists tooltip-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/tooltip/_tooltip-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds progress-spinner-base and emits MDC circular-progress unthemable tokens from progress-spinner-theme. The owned forward lists progress-spinner-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/progress-spinner/_progress-spinner-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds card-base and emits MDC elevated and outlined card unthemable tokens from card-theme. The owned forward lists card-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/card/_card-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch emits MDC card tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-card. styles/card/_card-theme.scss still nests the color, typography, and density token values under .mat-mdc-card. That selector was not changed.

The patch adds fab-base and emits MDC fab and extended-fab unthemable tokens from fab-theme. The owned forward lists fab-color, typography, density, and theme. styles/button has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch emits MDC tooltip tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-tooltip. styles/tooltip/_tooltip-theme.scss still nests the color, typography, and density token values under .mat-mdc-tooltip. That selector was not changed.

The patch adds slider-base and emits MDC slider unthemable tokens from slider-theme. The owned forward lists slider-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/slider/_slider-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch replaces a single dialog title id with a queue so aria-labelledby updates when a title is destroyed. MatLegacyDialogTitle already pushes its id onto _ariaLabelledByQueue and splices it out in ngOnDestroy, and the container already binds aria-labelledby to the first queued id. No source was changed.

The patch deletes 702 files, including the legacy component trees, and stops forwarding their Sass from _index.scss. This package still has all 22 legacy directories, from autocomplete through tooltip, and the facade still forwards them. None of those directories were deleted.

The patch inlines CDK_ROW_TEMPLATE and CDK_TABLE_TEMPLATE on the MDC table so local compilation can see the template. The owned legacy rows still use CDK_ROW_TEMPLATE with class mat-header-row. The owned table template is a separate inline template with thead and tbody. Those templates were not rewritten.

The patch deletes the shared _Mat*Base classes after the legacy components were removed, and folds that behavior into the current Mat* classes. This package still exports those bases, including _MatAutocompleteBase, _MatDialogBase, _MatSelectBase, _MatCheckboxBase, and _MatTooltipBase. None of those classes were removed.

The patch adds snack-bar-base and emits MDC snack-bar unthemable tokens from snack-bar-theme. The owned forward lists snack-bar-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/snack-bar/_snack-bar-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds list-base and emits MDC list unthemable tokens from list-theme. The owned forward lists list-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/list/_list-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch sets text-align left, and right under dir=rtl, on the MDC progress bar so a parent text-align does not shift it. This package has no MDC progress-bar.scss. The owned legacy rule is .mat-progress-bar, which has display block and no text-align. That rule was not changed.
The patch corrects the comment spelling autcomplete to autocomplete on requireSelection. legacy-autocomplete/internal/autocomplete-base.ts already uses the corrected spelling. No source was changed.

The patch sets cursor pointer on .mat-mdc-form-field-type-mat-select .mat-mdc-text-field-wrapper. This package has no such selector. The owned legacy select sets cursor pointer on .mat-select-trigger. That rule was not changed.

The patch moves the hover opacity from .mat-mdc-form-field:hover to .mat-mdc-text-field-wrapper:hover so the subscript does not show the hover state. styles/form-field/_form-field-focus-overlay.scss line 29 still uses .mat-mdc-form-field:hover. That selector was not changed.

The patch calls markForCheck on CdkTable when the no-data row is shown or hidden. MatLegacyTable extends CdkTable and does not reimplement that toggle. MatLegacyNoDataRow only sets the mat-no-data-row class. The CDK method was not copied into this package.

The patch adds dialog-base and emits MDC dialog unthemable tokens from dialog-theme. The owned forward lists dialog-theme, color, typography, density, and dialog-legacy-padding. styles/dialog/_dialog-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch emits MDC circular-progress color tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-progress-spinner. styles/progress-spinner/_progress-spinner-theme.scss still nests those tokens under .mat-mdc-progress-spinner, including the accent and warn rules. That selector was not changed.

The patch widens the MDC range thumb input at min and max by changing the ripple padding inside MatSliderRangeThumb. This package has no MatSliderRangeThumb and no slider-input. The owned legacy slider was not changed.

The patch updates MatSliderThumb so an iOS pointer on the thumb sets the active width and slider dimensions without also focusing the input. This package has no MatSliderThumb. The owned legacy slider was not changed.

The patch adds cdkConnectedOverlayDisposeOnNavigation on CdkConnectedOverlay and passes it into the overlay config. This package does not define that directive. The owned select template binds other cdkConnectedOverlay inputs and does not set disposeOnNavigation. That binding was not added.

The patch emits MDC snack-bar color and typography tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-snack-bar-container. styles/snack-bar/_snack-bar-theme.scss still nests both mixins under .mat-mdc-snack-bar-container. That selector was not changed.

The patch reads card, core, form-field, option, optgroup, progress-bar, pseudo-checkbox, and ripple themes through inspection.get-theme-color and theme-has. The owned copies of those themes still call theming.get-color-config. The inspection API was not added.

The patch sets word-break normal on .mdc-slider__value-indicator so a parent word-break does not change the MDC value indicator. This package has no MDC slider.scss. The owned legacy thumb label has no word-break rule, and none was added.
The patch only changes a comment on InteractivityChecker, from whether is is focusable to whether it is focusable. This package does not define that class. No source was changed.

The patch replaces mixinDisabled and mixinDisableRipple on MatMenuItem with booleanAttribute inputs. MatLegacyMenuItem still extends the peer menu item and still declares inputs disabled and disableRipple. The owned mixin helpers under legacy-menu/internal/common-behaviors remain.

The patch reads the remaining component themes through the inspection API and removes legacy-typography-hierarchy. The owned themes still call theming.get-color-config. The facade still forwards legacy-typography-hierarchy, and that mixin was not removed.
The patch sets aria-hidden on an inactive MDC tab panel. legacy-tabs/tab-group.html binds aria-labelledby on mat-tab-body and does not bind aria-hidden from selectedIndex. That binding was not added.

The patch marks an MDC dialog component host with mat-mdc-dialog-component-host and display contents so the surface flex layout reaches the title and actions. This package has no such class. MatLegacyDialogContainer does not override attachComponentPortal. That class was not added.

The patch stores the input value when the panel attaches, including when there are no options, and compares requireSelection against that value. legacy-autocomplete/internal/autocomplete-trigger-base.ts already calls _captureValueOnAttach on attach and on a later open, and compares the input to _valueOnAttach. No source was changed.

The patch replaces coerceBooleanProperty setters on CdkTrapFocus with booleanAttribute transforms for cdkTrapFocus and cdkTrapFocusAutoCapture. This package does not define that directive. No source was changed.

The patch replaces coerceBooleanProperty setters on CdkConnectedOverlay with booleanAttribute transforms for backdrop, lock position, flexible dimensions, grow after open, and push. This package does not define that directive. No source was changed.

The patch adds takeUntil on the CdkVirtualScrollViewport scrolled subscription so a provided CdkVirtualScrollableElement does not leak after the viewport is destroyed. This package does not define that class. The unsubscribe was not copied.

The patch emits MDC list color, density, and typography tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-list-base. styles/list/_list-theme.scss still nests those three mixins under .mat-mdc-list-base. That selector was not changed.

The patch sets cursor inherit on .mat-mdc-floating-label.mdc-floating-label so the label cursor matches the input. This package has no MDC text-field structure overrides file. The owned floating-label rules do not set that cursor, and the rule was not added.

The patch bumps the MDC canary and adds focus-ring-color and focus-ring-offset to the icon-button token map so snapshot tests match new MDC tokens. styles/core/tokens/m2/mdc/_icon-button.scss still ends the unthemable map at pressed-state-layer-opacity. Those keys were not added, and the MDC pin was not changed.

The patch adds radio-base and emits MDC radio unthemable tokens from radio-theme. The owned forward lists radio-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/radio/_radio-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch branches the tooltip theme on inspection.get-theme-version and adds experimental M3 tooltip tokens. styles/tooltip/_tooltip-theme.scss still calls theming.get-color-config and has no theme-version branch. The M3 token files were not added.

The patch branches the snack-bar theme on inspection.get-theme-version and adds experimental M3 snack-bar tokens. styles/snack-bar/_snack-bar-theme.scss still calls theming.get-color-config and has no theme-version branch. The M3 token files were not added.

The patch renames the typography map key font-famiy to font-family. This package has no m2-inspection or versioning file. styles/core/typography/_typography.scss line 327 still uses font-famiy in the 2014-to-2018 map. That key was not renamed.
The patch adds MatDateFnsModule and MatLuxonDateModule to the missing date-adapter error. This package does not define createMissingDateImplError. The message was not copied.

The patch sets standalone true on the dialog container, content directives, and dialog class. The owned dialog container and content directives still set standalone false. Those flags were not changed.

The patch clicks a tab link on Enter as well as Space when a tab panel is set, and still prevents the key when the link is disabled. legacy-tabs/internal/tab-nav-bar-base.ts _handleKeydown already does that. No source was changed.

The patch emits radio tokens with current-selector-or-root and applies radio density tokens on list item start and end. styles/radio/_radio-theme.scss still nests typography and density under .mat-mdc-radio-button. The list density mixin does not apply those radio tokens. Those selectors were not changed.

The patch adds aria-owns for the autocomplete panel on the tracked parent modal when the panel opens, and removes it when the panel closes. legacy-autocomplete/internal/autocomplete-trigger-base.ts openPanel and closePanel already do that. No source was changed.

The patch stops current-selector-or-root from lifting content into a later at-root block, which flipped declaration order. styles/core/style/_sass-utils.scss still uses @at-root with the current selector or html. That body was not changed.

The patch adds menu-base and emits menu unthemable tokens from menu-theme. The owned forward lists menu-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/menu/_menu-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds sidenav-base and emits sidenav unthemable tokens from sidenav-theme. The owned forward lists sidenav-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/sidenav/_sidenav-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch replaces the private table token helper with a public table-base mixin. The owned forward lists table-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/table/_table-theme.scss still uses the private _output-tokens mixin. That helper was not replaced.

The patch adds bottom-sheet-base and emits bottom-sheet unthemable tokens from bottom-sheet-theme. The owned forward lists bottom-sheet-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/bottom-sheet/_bottom-sheet-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch uses protected button color tokens for raised buttons and sets the disabled label to 0.5 opacity in a dark theme. styles/button/_button-theme.scss already themes .mat-mdc-raised-button with the protected theme, and its disabled ink is rgba of on-surface at 0.5 when is-dark is set. No source was changed.

The patch adds chips-base and emits MDC chip unthemable tokens from chips-theme. The owned forward lists chips-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/chips/_chips-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds tabs-base and emits tab, tab-indicator, and tab-header unthemable tokens from tabs-theme. The owned forward lists tabs-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/tabs/_tabs-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds button-toggle-base and emits legacy and standard button-toggle unthemable tokens from button-toggle-theme. The owned forward lists button-toggle-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/button-toggle/_button-toggle-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds slide-toggle-base and emits MDC switch unthemable tokens from slide-toggle-theme. The owned forward lists slide-toggle-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/slide-toggle/_slide-toggle-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.
The patch sets standalone true on the snack-bar container, simple snack bar, and content. The owned snack-bar container and simple snack bar still set standalone false. Those flags were not changed.

The patch emits fab color and extended-fab typography tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-fab and .mat-mdc-extended-fab. styles/button/_fab-theme.scss still nests the color variants under .mat-mdc-fab and the typography tokens under .mat-mdc-extended-fab. Those selectors were not changed.

The patch emits dialog color and typography tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-dialog-container. styles/dialog/_dialog-theme.scss still nests both under .mat-mdc-dialog-container. Those selectors were not changed.

The patch emits slider color, typography, and density tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-slider. styles/slider/_slider-theme.scss still nests the color and typography tokens under .mat-mdc-slider. Those selectors were not changed.

The patch adds empty base mixins for button, icon-button, core, ripple, pseudo-checkbox, divider, expansion, form-field, sort, and tree, forwards those names, and adds all-component-bases. The owned forwards list the historical theme, color, typography, and density names and do not include those base names. styles/core/theming/_all-theme.scss has no all-component-bases mixin, and those mixins were not added.

The patch renames the Material token maps from button-filled and button-protected to filled-button and protected-button, changing the prefixes to (mdc, filled-button) and (mdc, protected-button). styles/core/tokens/m2/mdc has no button-filled or button-protected token map. The vendor MDC theme files already set custom-property-prefix to filled-button and protected-button. Those maps were not added.

The patch emits expansion unthemable tokens from the expansion base mixin and removes that emission from the panel stylesheet. The owned forward lists expansion-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/expansion/_expansion-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch doubles .mat-mdc-button-base in the toolbar so an unthemed button inherits the toolbar label color. The owned package has styles/toolbar/_toolbar-theme.scss and no structural toolbar.scss. That doubled selector is not present, and it was not added.

The patch emits divider unthemable tokens from the divider base mixin and removes that emission from divider.scss. The owned forward lists divider-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/divider/_divider-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch emits filled text-field, outlined text-field, and form-field unthemable tokens from the form-field base mixin and removes those emissions from form-field.scss. The owned forward lists form-field-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/form-field/_form-field-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch emits icon-button unthemable tokens from the icon-button base mixin and removes that emission from icon-button.scss. The owned forward lists icon-button-color, typography, density, and theme. styles/button/_icon-button-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch binds aria-checked to mixed on the checkbox input while it is indeterminate. The owned legacy checkbox input binds aria-label, aria-labelledby, and aria-describedby and does not bind aria-checked. That binding was not added.

The patch replaces *ngIf and *ngFor with @if and @for in chips, option, datepicker, expansion, form-field, list, menu, paginator, select, sidenav, slide-toggle, slider, snack-bar, sort, stepper, and tabs templates. The owned templates for those families still use *ngIf and *ngFor. They were not rewritten.

The patch changes MatDialog._dialog from private to protected so a subclass can replace the CDK dialog. legacy-dialog/internal/dialog-base.ts still declares private _dialog: Dialog. That visibility was not changed.

The patch removes ripple-theme-styles and emits button ripple colors as token slots. styles/button/_button-theme-private.scss still defines ripple-theme-styles and --mat-mdc-button-persistent-ripple-color. The button, fab, and icon-button themes still call that mixin. Those token maps were not added.

The patch adds a ripple token map and emits ripple color through current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-ripple-element. styles/core/ripple/_ripple-theme.scss still sets the element background from get-color-config. There is no styles/core/tokens/m2/mat/_ripple.scss, and that token map was not added.

The patch changes isFakeMousedownFromScreenReader to test event.detail instead of offsetX and offsetY. That function is imported from @angular/cdk/a11y by the owned menu trigger and ripple renderer. It is not defined in this package, and the CDK body was not copied.

The patch changes const enum to enum for CDK types and for TransitionCheckState, RippleState, and MatDialogState. The owned ripple state is already export enum LegacyRippleState. The package has no const enum declarations. TransitionCheckState and MatDialogState are re-exported from the peer and are not defined here.

The patch reads item._lines instead of item._titles for the line count and changes the list-item content checks from throw to console.warn. That check is on MatListItemBase. The owned list items have a _lines query and no _titles field or sanityCheckListItemContent function. That function was not added.

The patch clears the previous autocomplete option inside _updateNativeInputValue when the new value is falsy, which covers a reactive form reset. The owned trigger clears that option from _handleInput when the typed value is empty. _updateNativeInputValue only writes the input and _previousValue, and that reset call was not added.
The patch starts a date-range drag from cell.compareValue instead of cell.rawValue. The owned package has no calendar-body.ts and no compareValue or rawValue field. That comparison was not copied.

The patch sets line-height inherit on .mat-mdc-raised-button inside the button typography mixin. styles/button/_button-theme.scss typography mixin includes the MDC typography query and does not set that line-height. The rule was not added.

The patch adds experimental M3 sort, stepper, table, tabs, and tree tokens and branches those themes on inspection.get-theme-version. styles/sort/_sort-theme.scss still calls the companion bridge with get-color-config. The package has no get-theme-version call and no M3 token files. Those branches were not added.

The patch captures the autocomplete input only when the overlay is first attached, and removes the later captures that ran while the user was filtering. The owned trigger still calls _captureValueOnAttach after every attach and again when the panel opens. That timing was not changed.

The patch adds .mat-mdc-button to the typography rule that sets line-height inherit. styles/button/_button-theme.scss typography mixin includes the MDC typography query and does not set that line-height. The rule was not added.

The patch adds .mat-mdc-unelevated-button to the typography rule that sets line-height inherit. styles/button/_button-theme.scss typography mixin includes the MDC typography query and does not set that line-height. The rule was not added.

The patch deselects the selected autocomplete option while typing when the input no longer matches that option's display value and requireSelection is off. The owned _handleInput clears the previous option only when the typed value is empty. That display comparison was not added.

The patch adds experimental M3 menu and divider tokens and branches those themes on inspection.get-theme-version. styles/menu/_menu-theme.scss and styles/divider/_divider-theme.scss still call get-color-config. The package has no get-theme-version call and no M3 token files. Those branches were not added.

The patch adds experimental M3 dialog tokens and branches the dialog theme on inspection.get-theme-version. styles/dialog/_dialog-theme.scss still nests color and typography under .mat-mdc-dialog-container and calls get-color-config. The package has no get-theme-version call and no M3 token files. Those branches were not added.

The patch raises the non-interactive tooltip selector to .mat-mdc-tooltip-panel.mat-mdc-tooltip-panel-non-interactive. legacy-tooltip/tooltip.scss still uses .mat-tooltip-panel-non-interactive alone for pointer-events none. That selector was not changed.

The patch aliases MatFormFieldControl and adds a local interface that extends it so Closure property renaming keeps the control shape. legacy-form-field/form-field.ts queries ContentChild(MatFormFieldControl) directly. That alias and interface were not added.

The patch marks CDK test components standalone and gives CDK_CONNECTED_OVERLAY_SCROLL_STRATEGY a root factory that calls overlay.scrollStrategies.reposition. That token and the CDK specs are not defined in this package. The factory was not copied.

The patch sets standalone true on CdkMonitorFocus, CdkTrapFocus, and CdkAriaLive and imports those directives into A11yModule. Those classes are not defined in this package. The standalone flags were not copied.
The patch sets standalone true on CdkPortal, CdkPortalOutlet, and the portal module directives. Those classes are not defined in this package. The standalone flags were not copied.

The patch sets standalone true on MatLine, MatOption, MatOptgroup, MatRipple, and MatPseudoCheckbox. The owned option and optgroup still set standalone false. MatLine and MatRipple are not defined here. The owned pseudo-checkbox is already standalone true. The option and optgroup flags were not changed.

The patch sets standalone true on MatTestDialogOpener and imports it into its testing module. The owned MatTestLegacyDialogOpener still sets standalone false and stays in declarations. The snack-bar ref change only wraps the constructor. Those flags were not changed.

The patch sets standalone true on the form field, error, hint, label, prefix, suffix, floating label, line ripple, and notched outline. The owned form field, error, hint, label, prefix, and suffix still set standalone false. The floating label, line ripple, and notched outline are not defined here. Those flags were not changed.

The patch sets standalone true on the menu, menu item, menu trigger, and menu content. The owned menu, menu item, menu trigger, and menu content still set standalone false. Those flags were not changed.
The patch sets standalone true on MatTooltip and TooltipComponent. The owned tooltip directive and tooltip component still set standalone false. Those flags were not changed.

The patch imports CdkPortalOutlet instead of PortalModule on the already-standalone dialog container and makes the outlet tag self-closing. The owned dialog container still sets standalone false, and its template still uses a paired cdkPortalOutlet element. The dialog module still imports PortalModule. Those imports were not changed.

The patch imports MatButton and CdkPortalOutlet instead of MatButtonModule and PortalModule on the already-standalone snack-bar classes. The owned simple snack bar and container still set standalone false. The snack-bar module still imports PortalModule and MatLegacyButtonModule. Those imports were not changed.

The patch adds .mat-mdc-outlined-button to the typography rule that sets line-height inherit. styles/button/_button-theme.scss typography mixin includes the MDC typography query and does not set that line-height. The rule was not added.

The patch makes MatCheckbox provide NG_VALIDATORS and deprecates the separate required-validator directive. The owned checkbox does not implement Validator. The required validator remains a separate directive exported by the checkbox module. That split was not changed.

The patch makes MatSlideToggle provide NG_VALIDATORS and deprecates the separate required-validator directive. The owned slide toggle does not implement Validator. The required validator remains a separate directive exported by the slide-toggle module. That split was not changed.
The patch floors the MDC slider tick counts and offsets the thumb by the tick-mark inset. The package has no slider-input and no tick-mark counter. Those calculations were not added.

The patch adds the docs-private internal form field and a form-field token map, then uses that field in the MDC checkbox, radio, and slide-toggle templates. The package has no internal form field. The owned templates still use mat-checkbox-layout, mat-radio-label, and mat-slide-toggle-label. That field was not added.

The patch tracks ripple hosts in the private MatRippleLoader and destroys the host ripple from the button and chip. The package has no ripple loader. The owned ripple renderer still destroys an individual ripple ref when its transition ends. That loader was not added.

The patch removes the FAB typography without-ripple include and limits the structural static styles to the base query. styles/button/_fab-theme.scss still includes mdc-fab.without-ripple. The package has no structural fab.scss. That include was not removed.

limitations: The other 927 behavior-semantic SHAs were not read.
